DIGITAL MEDIA LANDSCAPE
=========================

+------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                   THE DIGITAL PUBLIC SPHERE                      |
|                                                                  |
|  CONTENT CREATION     DISTRIBUTION         CONSUMPTION           |
|  ----------------     ------------         -----------           |
|  Web writing          Search (Google)       Browser              |
|  Social media posts   Feed algorithm        Mobile apps          |
|  UX copy              Email / push          Notifications        |
|  Video scripts        CDN / hosting         Video players        |
|  Podcast scripts      Social amplification  Podcatchers          |
|                                                                  |
|  CONTENT STRATEGY     PLATFORM SYSTEMS      ATTENTION ECONOMY    |
|  Governance           Algorithms            Engagement           |
|  Taxonomy             Network effects       Dark patterns        |
|  Voice/tone           Lock-in               Metrics              |
|  Audit                Moderation                                 |
|                                                                  |
|  UNDERLYING ECONOMIC MODEL: ATTENTION ECONOMY                    |
|  "If you're not paying for the product, you are the product"     |
|  Advertisers pay for access to attention; users supply it        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------+

HABERMAS'S PUBLIC SPHERE -> DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION
====================================================

CLASSICAL PUBLIC SPHERE:
  Conditions: rational discourse, equal participation,
              consensus-seeking, separation from state and market
  Institutions: coffeehouses, newspapers, pamphlets
  Access: bourgeois (class-limited but ideologically open)

DIGITAL PUBLIC SPHERE (current state):
  Platforms: owned by private corporations
  Algorithm: shapes what is visible and to whom
  Advertising: fuses market and discourse
  Gatekeeping: formal (moderation) + algorithmic
  Participation: asymmetric (broadcast vs. social vs. interest)
  Discourse quality: context collapse, performance, toxicity

HABERMASIAN CRITIQUE OF DIGITAL:
  The algorithmic feed amplifies conflict and emotion
  because these drive engagement -> ad revenue
  This inverts the deliberative ideal:
  the system rewards the least deliberative content

ALTERNATIVE READING (Shirky, Yochai Benkler):
  Lower barriers to participation = more voices
  Networked public sphere can be more democratic
  Traditional gatekeepers (editors, publishers) had their own biases
  Power law distribution of attention is not unique to digital

The optimist/pessimist divide on digital public sphere is real
and not resolved; both sides have evidence.

SOCIAL PLATFORM TYPES
======================

BY GRAPH TYPE:
  Broadcast asymmetric: Twitter/X, Substack
    -> Followers don't automatically follow back
    -> Designed for public broadcasting
    -> Celebrity/influencer dynamic baked in

  Social graph symmetric: Facebook, LinkedIn
    -> Mutual connections (friends, connections)
    -> Designed for existing relationships
    -> Privacy defaults matter more

  Interest graph: TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest
    -> Not primarily about who you know
    -> About what you like / watch / click
    -> Maximally algorithmic (no social graph needed to start)

  Ephemeral: Snapchat, Instagram Stories, BeReal
    -> Content disappears (reduces permanence anxiety)
    -> Designed for casual, frequent posting

  Professional: LinkedIn
    -> Resume + broadcast + weak social graph
    -> Content performance = signaling to employers/clients

BY CONTENT TYPE:
  Text primary: Twitter/X, Mastodon, Bluesky
  Image primary: Instagram, Pinterest
  Video primary: TikTok, YouTube, Twitch
  Audio primary: Clubhouse (mostly dead), podcast RSS
  Long-form: Substack, Medium

ATTENTION ECONOMY MECHANICS
=============================

GOLDHABER (1997): "The attention economy"
  Information abundance -> attention scarcity
  Attention is the new scarce resource
  Whoever commands attention commands economic value

HOW IT WORKS:
  Users: trade attention for "free" service
  Advertisers: pay platforms for access to users' attention
  Platforms: maximize attention duration and return frequency
             to maximize advertiser value

ENGAGEMENT METRICS (the currency):
  Time on site / watch time    <- most valuable signal
  Daily/monthly active users   <- scale signal
  Clicks, views                <- surface engagement
  Shares, saves                <- intention signal
  Comments, reactions          <- participation signal

PERVERSE INCENTIVE STRUCTURE:
  Content that provokes outrage -> high engagement
  Conspiracy content: initially engaging
  Emotionally extreme content: watched longer, shared more
  "Move fast and break things" applied to attention:
  optimization for engagement breaks discourse

ATTENTION ECONOMY FEEDBACK LOOP
==================================

  CONTENT CREATION                        ALGORITHMIC CURATION
  ┌──────────────────┐                    ┌──────────────────┐
  │ Creator publishes│                    │ Platform ranks by│
  │ text / image /   │ ──── submit ────→  │ predicted engage-│
  │ video / audio    │                    │ ment (watch time,│
  │                  │                    │ clicks, shares,  │
  │ Incentives:      │                    │ comments, saves) │
  │  reach, revenue, │                    └──────────────────┘
  │  status, mission │                             │
  └──────────────────┘                             │ surface to
        ↑                                          │ feed / FYP /
        │                                          │ search results
        │                                          v
        │                                 ┌──────────────────┐
        │                                 │   CONSUMPTION    │
        │                                 │                  │
        │                                 │ User scrolls,    │
        │                                 │ watches, reads,  │
        │                                 │ skips            │
        │                                 └──────────────────┘
        │                                          │
        │              ┌──────────────────┐        │
        │              │ ENGAGEMENT SIGNAL│        │
        │              │                  │ ←──────┘
        │              │ Like, share,     │        │
        │              │ comment, watch   │        │
        │              │ duration, save,  │        │
        │              │ click-through    │        │
        │              └──────────────────┘        │
        │                       │
        │                       │ feeds back to
        │                       v
        │              ┌──────────────────┐
        └──────────────│ CREATOR ADAPTS   │
   creator sees what   │                  │
   gets reach and      │ Analytics dash-  │
   optimizes for it    │ board shows what │
   (thumbnail style,   │ "worked" → next  │
   hook timing, topic  │ content tilts    │
   selection, outrage  │ toward whatever  │
   framing)            │ the algorithm    │
                       │ rewarded         │
                       └──────────────────┘

  THE RATCHET EFFECT:
  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │ Algorithm rewards engagement → creators optimize for   │
  │ engagement → content becomes more engaging (emotional, │
  │ extreme, short) → audience habituates → algorithm must │
  │ find even more engaging content → escalation cycle.    │
  │                                                        │
  │ This is why "just don't watch it" fails as policy —    │
  │ the system is designed to defeat that intention.       │
  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

FORMAT SELECTION DECISION TREE
================================

  What's your goal?
       │
       ├── Reach strangers at scale? ──→ SHORT VIDEO (TikTok / Reels / Shorts)
       │
       ├── Build authority in a field? ──→ LONG-FORM TEXT (Substack / LinkedIn / Blog)
       │
       ├── Compound over time (SEO)? ──→ EVERGREEN WEB CONTENT + YouTube
       │
       ├── Own the relationship? ──→ EMAIL NEWSLETTER (no algorithm between you and reader)
       │
       ├── Real-time conversation? ──→ TWITTER / BLUESKY (text) or TWITCH (video)
       │
       └── Niche community? ──→ DISCORD / REDDIT / PRIVATE GROUP
